purpose: Resolve exactly one executable for treatment-blind future-consequence grounding from the release selected by predicate G, without discretionary source builds or platform choices.

pre_freeze_packaging_evidence.wrapper_optional_dependency_rule_observe: @biomejs/cli-linux-x64 is pinned to the exact wrapper version

selected_version: exact version string of the single stable @biomejs/biome release selected by the frozen A/G rule
registry_source: official npm registry package metadata and tarballs for the exact selected version

artifact_rule.wrapper_metadata: resolve @biomejs/biome@<selected_version>; require package name and version exact
artifact_rule.dependency_check: wrapper metadata must declare @biomejs/cli-linux-x64 at exactly <selected_version>
artifact_rule.binary_metadata: resolve @biomejs/cli-linux-x64@<selected_version>; require package name/version exact and os=linux cpu=x64 libc=glibc when those fields are present
artifact_rule.integrity: both tarballs must be verified against the registry-provided dist.integrity; if unavailable or verification fails, artifact is NOT_IDENTIFIED
artifact_rule.content_addressing: record SHA-256 of both verified tarball byte streams and the extracted executable byte stream before witness execution
artifact_rule.executable_member: require exactly one regular-file member package/biome in the verified @biomejs/cli-linux-x64 tarball; symlink/hardlink/device members at that path are rejected
artifact_rule.invocation: invoke the extracted package/biome directly with arguments ['migrate','--write']; do not use the JavaScript wrapper, package-manager resolution, BIOME_BINARY override, source compilation, or a different platform package

grounding_runtime.working_directory: fresh isolated directory containing exactly the frozen witness configuration filesystem before invocation
grounding_runtime.environment: frozen allowlist only; no arm/treatment variables; no BIOME_BINARY override; locale and timezone fixed

independence.artifact_version_source: only the version selected by A/G
independence.platform_choice: frozen pre-freeze as linux-x64-glibc; not selected after future results
